page.layout: One page of running text, with no marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Signature centred at the foot. The Haec communia sentence is centred in italic.

main_text.p: Capsula cordis est membrana firma, vesicæ instar, cui quasi thecæ alicui cor est impositum.
Inferioris cavitatis peculiares membranæ sunt, Peri-tonæum, Omentum, & Mesenterium.
Peritonæum est membrana, totam inferiorem trunci cavitatem cum visceribus, & reliquis con-tentis omnibus, ambiens & complectens.
Omentum est membrana, ventriculum & inte-stina integens.
Mesenterium est membrana, plurimis tenuissi-mis venis (Mesaraicis dictis) intertexta, intestina undiq; connectens, dorsoq; alligans.
Mesaraicæ venulæ sunt, per quas melior pars chyli ex intestinis superioribus ad epar trahitur, ita ut in his jam sanguinis rudimentum quod-dam accipiat.
Exterius communiter obtinent animalia hæc mem-bra progressiva, Pedes quatuor. unde etiam Qua-drupeda vocantur.
Illorum pedum, duo anteriores retrorsum, posteriores antrorsum tantùm, in progressione seu incessu flectuntur [?].

p.i: Hæc communia sunt utriq; sexui animalium istorum membra.

main_text.p: Peculiare porrò maribus membrum est exterius, Scrotum : membrana firma, sacci instar, in quam extra reliquum truncum testiculi maris propen-dent.

page.notes: Page number "73" is uncertain at the top right; it could be 75. Signature at the foot reads "F ij" but could be "F 2". The word "flectuntur" is set with a ligature and is marked [?]. The spelling "tantùm" is copied as printed. A small mark before "Exterius" at the left edge is not a legible note and has been left out. No catchword is printed.
